::: {.hero}
# Advanced perception for unpredictable environments
:::

::: {.ethos-section}

::: {.ethos-content}
Traditional SLAM systems struggle in messy, real-world environments. We address this by creating visual features that stay consistent under scale and orientation changes, incorporating optical flow to maintain tracking in low-texture scenes, and building semantic maps that distinguish between stable and dynamic landmarks. We are also extending ground models with LiDAR to improve shadow detection and terrain understanding, so users get maps that remain accurate and actionable in the field.

We focus on developer experience as much as core capability. Our platform makes perception plug-and-play. With SDKs and tooling that fuse LiDAR, IMU, GNSS, and camera data—plus GPU-accelerated processing, calibration, and analytics—developers can deliver reliable performance without reinventing the stack. 
:::
